blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Six armed men linked to the outlawed Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters (BIFF) were killed Saturday in a law enforcement operation in Barangay Balong in the Special Geographic Area (SGA) of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). The Philippine National Police, backed by the Armed Forces of the Philippines, launched an operation to serve arrest warrants against BIFF commander Zoren of the Bungos faction, who is facing carnapping and homicide cases. Brig. Gen. Ricky Bunayog, commander of the Army’s 6th Infantry Division, said the operatives came under fire as they approached the location of the suspect and […]...
